ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.7.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Aura Algorithm Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Core/wiki
Meet Aura (The AI Storyteller!) Aura Algorithm actively monitors the narrative threads of your colony. She does not just throw random events at you; she watches your choices, evaluates the psychological state of your pawns, and crafts bespoke scenarios and quests to test your morals and sanity. Her threat scaling uses traditional colony wealth as a baseline logical cost-benefit analysis, but the frequency and type of threats are dynamically orchestrated.
NOTE: Aura requires an active LLM connection to orchestrate her narrative intelligence. If the LLM becomes disconnected or unresponsive, her storytelling logic will automatically fall back to Classic Cassandra.
--- Roadmap --- 0.6 - Agent and Tool Foundation: delivered in v0.6.0. 0.7 - Regions and Territories Compatibility: basic pass-through alongside Empire Refactored and World Domination. Territories set tax rates; the regular game mechanics are left alone. 0.8 - Demographics, News and Narrative Voice: regional ideology and new map overlays, a newspaper driven by what actually happens on the world map, Aura's own personality, and local text-to-speech. 0.9 - Factions and Living Societies: state ideologies, conversion and ideological spread, ideological sites and spies - building toward living NPC societies. 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: bringing every module back together for another pass over what the whole set can do. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog --- v0.7.0 - Regions and Territories Compatibility - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged. v0.6.1 - Fixed: the in-game mod list showed v0.5.2 with no 0.6.0 notes; version and changelog now agree everywhere - Roadmap updated: 0.7 is Regions and Territories compatibility (groundwork for Factions, which will require Empire) v0.6.0 - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.6.0 (Agent and Tool Foundation) - Requires Core v0.6.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged - In-game wiki guides updated; "MCP" renamed to game tools throughout
